limitations: One paired software-emulator run; repeat adverse/noisy cases before acceptance.
An identical-APK control measures environment variation and cannot accept a new renderer.
HWUI quantiles cover its recent CSV ring; actual presentation polling covers the complete motion.
PSS trend is a short bounded soak, not proof of indefinite memory stability.
Separate interaction/upgrade/save smoke and visual review are required before the phase gate.
No fixed physical-device FPS or isolated hardware GPU utilization claimed.

conclusion: Complete real A-I input/presentation matrix with unchanged scope and10% tail/32MiB limits. No incomplete-capture excuse or callback FPS.
Single failing metric: horizontal-pan P95+17.66%; no other primary tail crossed10%. Zoom-out P95-37.21%, P99-31.68%, continuousLOD P99-35.68%.
Peak extended PSS459361->440203KiB, within32MiB limit; short bounded soak only.
Immutable interaction/monthly/LOD and visual checks passed. This does not override the failing primary metric.
Candidate is unaccepted; no2.3 Release/main merge, no later gameplay stage.
Dev8 includes required upfront bounds preparation at82039b6; its own compiled APK and full native gate remain pending. Do not assume the safety change fixes the pan timing.
